# Method SetDescription

#### SetDescription(ElementId, string)

Sets the description of an element.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
void SetDescription(ElementId inElementId, string inDescription)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Identifier of the element to modify.  |  
 
|  string |  inDescription |  New description of the element.  |  

##### Remarks

StartModification(string, bool) and EnsureIsDirty(ref DocumentId) must be called before calling this method.
 
This method is available since v7.6.
